title: Projection graticules (PROJ)
description: PROJ, through pyproj, transforms a synthetic geographic grid into Mollweide and Mercator coordinates. No map tiles are downloaded.

prompt: Projection graticules. Inspect the locally generated results and rerun the included recipe when changing simulation inputs.
